context: Consolidation reflection after a failed install-dsh run on the owner's EFS-encrypted laptop (C:\Users\owner uses EFS)
fix: Use raw file copy with decryption on EFS-encrypted directories; probe EFS before install and switch the copy strategy.

context: Install reported success but the post-install verify read back ciphertext from the installed binary on the EFS-encrypted profile
error: install-dsh: verify failed — read of C:\Users\owner\.dsh\bin\dsh.exe returned ciphertext
fix: Verify EFS-copied files through a decryption handle instead of plain ReadFile, and treat ciphertext reads as a failed install.

context: Install under AppData\Roaming\dsh (a junction to C:\tools\dsh); the copier followed the junction during copy
error: install-dsh: warning: junction C:\Users\owner\AppData\Roaming\dsh -> C:\tools\dsh followed during copy; files landed on the wrong target
fix: Resolve junctions for every path component before choosing the install root and copy only to the resolved target path.

context: Install under AppData\Roaming\dsh (a junction to C:\tools\dsh); the copier followed the junction during copy
error: install-dsh: warning: junction C:\Users\owner\AppData\Roaming\dsh -> C:\tools\dsh followed during copy; files landed on the wrong target
fix: Resolve junctions for every path component before choosing the install root and copy only to the resolved target path.

context: Directory traversal hit a junction loop A -> B -> A while copying under the install root
error: install-dsh: verify stage: junction loop A -> B -> A caused infinite recursion
fix: Traverse with a visited set of resolved canonical paths and a depth cap so a junction loop fails fast with a clear message instead of recursing forever.

context: Service creation on a fresh install; the DSH agent service credential contains characters CreateServiceW rejects
error: install-dsh: sc.exe create failed (error 1069): the service credential was rejected by CreateServiceW
fix: Quote and escape the service credential when building sc.exe create and confirm the service actually starts before declaring the install complete.

context: Owner report (Q3): after a successful install the DSH service failed on first login
error: sc.exe query shows DSH Agent in state STOPPED with error 1069 on first login after install
fix: Start the service with the quoted credential as part of the install; verify the running state; surface sc.exe query output in the failure report.

context: Fresh install finished but the current shell still cannot find the dsh command
error: install-dsh: 'dsh' is not recognized as an internal or external command
fix: After adding the bin directory to the user PATH, instruct the user to open a new shell (or run refreshenv); the installer must not claim PATH is live in the current process.

context: Owner report (Q3): installer exited 0 but the binary is missing
error: install-dsh returned exit code 0 but C:\Users\owner\.dsh\bin\dsh.exe is missing
fix: After the copy stage, verify the marker and the binary exist before exiting 0; on a missing binary, fail with a nonzero exit and the full copy log.
